title: A phpinfo page is served (/phpinfo.php)
summary: phpinfo reveals the full PHP configuration, absolute paths, loaded modules, environment variables and more.

confirm.control: A path that cannot exist, so the site's not found answer is known.
confirm.differential: status==200 and body_contains("phpinfo()") and body_contains("PHP Version") and body_differs(control)

remediate: Remove the phpinfo file from the web root.
